executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 43 errors due to missing critical dependencies. Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 packages are not available on the classpath, causing widespread compilation failures across security configuration, repository interfaces, entity classes, and utility classes.

errors.message: Missing Spring Security dependencies: packages org.springframework.security.* do not exist
errors.root_cause: Spring Security starter dependency is missing from pom.xml. The SecurityConfig class requires Spring Security packages for HttpSecurity, SecurityFilterChain, and EnableWebSecurity annotations.

errors.message: Missing Spring Data JPA dependencies: packages org.springframework.data.* do not exist
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA starter dependency is missing from pom.xml. Repository interfaces (ColumnRepository, TaskRepository, UserRepository) and controllers (TaskManagementController, UserTaskController) require Spring Data JPA packages for JpaRepository, Page, Pageable, Query, Modifying, and Param annotations.

errors.message: Missing Jakarta Persistence dependency: package jakarta.persistence does not exist
errors.root_cause: Jakarta Persistence API is not available. Entity class BoardColumn requires JPA annotations (@Entity, @Table, @Id, @Column, @GeneratedValue, @ManyToOne, @JoinColumn) which are part of jakarta.persistence package.
errors.fix_recommendation: Jakarta Persistence is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa. Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency is added to pom.xml as it transitively includes jakarta.persistence-api.

errors.message: Missing Apache Commons Lang3 dependency: package org.apache.commons.lang3 does not exist
errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 library is missing from pom.xml. ValidationUtils class requires StringUtils or other utilities from commons-lang3.

summary: 4 dependency errors found causing 43 compilation failures
